drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 13.2% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 0.4% lower in 30 days' time (Dec) than now (Nov).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is below the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day dip only half, so it starts 1.6% higher than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -23.3% to +12.3% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 11.7% on average at 30 days, vs 10.5% for "price stays the same" - it is NOT better than no-change here, so read it as a range, not a number. Direction right 56% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.

rules.english:
2026-11-16 Silver - BUY (score +2 of 5): If buying: Buy gradually, in parts.  If holding: Hold - don't rush to sell.
Why: Mainly because the price is in the cheap part of the year's range and it fell very fast, and such falls often bounce back.
What would change it: BUY holds even if the price moves 15% either way.
How sure: Medium. Past BUY days (946 since 2017): higher 30 days later on 65% vs 54% of all days -> edge +11 points.
Price: Rs 1,51,256 per kg (Rs 1,55,793 with 3% GST); 7 days -9.8%, 30 days -17.4%. 30-day outlook Rs 1,39,139 (likely Rs 1,16,059 - Rs 1,69,852).
Saving for years: GO SLOW - The long-run signs are weak right now: keep the small regular buys, but avoid one big purchase now. Because the long wave is down (below the 200-day average).
rules.telugu:
2026-11-16 వెండి - కొనండి (స్కోరు +2 / 5)
ఎందుకు: ముఖ్య కారణం: ధర ఈ ఏడాది పరిధిలో తక్కువ భాగంలో ఉంది మరియు చాలా వేగంగా పడిపోయింది, ఇలాంటప్పుడు తరచుగా మళ్ళీ పెరుగుతుంది.
ఏది మారిస్తే మారుతుంది: ధర 15% అటూ ఇటూ మారినా ఇదే సూచన.
నమ్మకం: మధ్యస్థం. గతంలో BUY రోజుల్లో (946 రోజులు) 30 రోజుల తర్వాత 65% సార్లు ధర పెరిగింది; ఏ రోజైనా 54% (తేడా +11).
ధర: కిలోకు Rs 1,51,256 (GST తో Rs 1,55,793); 7 రోజుల్లో -9.8%, 30 రోజుల్లో -17.4%. 30 రోజుల అంచనా Rs 1,39,139 (Rs 1,16,059 - Rs 1,69,852).
ఏళ్ల తరబడి దాచుకునేవారికి: నెమ్మదిగా కొనండి - దీర్ఘకాల సంకేతాలు ఇప్పుడు బలహీనంగా ఉన్నాయి: చిన్న క్రమమైన కొనుగోళ్లు కొనసాగించండి, ఇప్పుడు ఒకేసారి పెద్ద మొత్తం కొనకండి. కారణం: దీర్ఘకాల ధోరణి కిందికి ఉంది (200 రోజుల సగటు కింద).
